Now, clearly, 0:03:42.710 --> 0:03:44.790 they have set the course for a rebuild with the 0:03:44.840 --> 0:03:48.220 trades yesterday. It's really interesting. It's 0:04:06.990 --> 0:04:09.410 an X factor that you have to keep in mind 0:04:09.710 --> 0:04:11.410 as we approach the trade deadline with the Colts. 0:04:12.510 --> 0:04:14.350 Well, you've got a new owner here. 0:04:14.410 --> 0:04:16.330 You also have a new general manager in the sense 0:04:16.350 --> 0:04:19.250 that Ed Dodds is the interim GM here with Chris 0:04:19.290 --> 0:04:22.390 Ballard having been fired by the team. title: How likely is it for Caleb Williams to make an MVP push in 2026?
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has impressed a lot of people around the NFL with his play in recent games. Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote consider how likely a run at MVP is for Williams.

title: What did Montez Sweat say about his PED suspension?
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote listen to what Bears defensive end Montez Sweat had to say about the performance-enhancing drug violation that resulted in his two-game suspension.

title: What type of trade would make sense for the Bears?
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: With the NFL trade deadline approaching, Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote ponder what type of move makes sense for these Bears. Could a trade for Chargers edge rusher (and former Bear) Khalil Mack work?
